decisionBox.changed: The $64,300 add trigger that fired-then-rejected at midday reclaimed AND HELD into the close (BTC ~$64,370), so the mildly-bullish tilt is confirmed rather than faded. But price sits right under the $65,406/$65,631 double-rejection zone heading into the highest-risk overnight gap (next report ~02:00), with F&G 27 and weekend outflows — a poor location to chase leverage or add size. Express the confirmed reclaim with only a small defensive spot DCA into the long-term core, keep the bulk of cash dry as overnight powder for a gap-down toward $63,000/$62,200, and keep futures flat. No resting stop is set on the wallet because price is far above the $63,000 reduce level and near resistance, not near the invalidation.

overnightRisk: Next report is ~02:00 COT, so the wallet carries an unhedged spot-only core through the thin weekend/Asia overnight window — where the worst gaps happen. Specific catalysts: (1) BTC is pinned under the $65,406 rejection high and the ~$65,631 50-month EMA — a failed retest there can snap price back toward $63,700 then the $62,200 magnet fast on low weekend depth; (2) sentiment is fragile (F&G 27) with a $225M spot-ETF outflow day just behind, so any risk-off headline into the Monday open can gap BTC down; (3) no fresh derivatives positioning could be verified this run (OKX feed stale), so leverage crowding is a blind spot. Plan: no leverage overnight; if a gap-down tags $63,000 with a 4H close below, scale the core down toward EXIT and treat $62,200 as the last line. Dry powder (~$24 cash) is reserved to DCA a gap-down toward the $62,200 shelf, not to chase strength.
